name: WimbleWorld
desc:
🎾 Welcome to Wimbledon: Tennis Showdown 2026🎾

New Update!

✈️Compete in the Wimbledon x Emirates Cup for the chance to unlock exclusive rewards.
🚀Up, up and away with the all new Emirates Jetpack obby!
🎁Earn limited-edition UGC designed by WhoseTrade - available while supplies last.

😎Switch up your style with all new rackets and gear to kit out your avatar.
🥇Play with friends and compete against others to gain MMR points.
📇 Track your stats on the player card!

🌟 Step onto the hallowed grass of the All England Lawn Tennis Club. Meet your heroes, collect coins and compete against friends or AI at the most famous tennis tournament! 

Tags: Tennis, Sports, Wimbledon
